第5章 皇城尤物苏媚娘（第1页）
“啧啧，苏楼主这身段，真是越来越勾人了……"
“你找死啊？跟苏媚娘有染的男人，哪个活过三个月？听说都是被榨干的……”
“都说三十如狼，四十如虎。这苏媚娘啊，是只千年王八，咬住就不撒口！”
“你们几个活腻了？这话要是传到苏楼主耳朵里，小心把你们全阉了！”
“话说回来，这叶凡胆子够肥啊，敢在万宝楼闹事。”
“可不是嘛，苏楼主动怒，叶家怕是要跟着倒霉……"
此时，万宝楼外已聚集不少看热闹的人，男人们窃窃私语，眼睛始终舍不得从苏媚娘身上移开。
叶凡保持着镇定，指了指一旁瑟瑟发抖的掌柜，“用二十块下品灵石，强收我两枚九转聚灵丹，这就是万宝楼的生财之道吗？”
转身朝掌柜勾了勾手指，那掌柜早已吓得魂不附体，颤巍巍地将丹药奉上。
苏媚娘翘起兰花指，拈起一枚丹药仔细瞧了起来，“还真是九转聚灵丹……小弟弟，这两枚丹药，你是从哪儿弄来的？”
叶凡笑而不语，目光在周围扫视一圈。
苏媚娘会意，瞥了眼掌柜后转头对侍卫吩咐道，“从今往后，他不再是万宝楼的掌柜。按规矩处置。”
“楼主饶命！小的知错了！小的只是一时鬼迷心窍……”
他知道万宝楼的规矩有多狠，这一处置不死也得脱层皮。
然而任他如何求饶，苏媚娘连个眼神都懒得施舍。
“小弟弟，这一百块下品灵石，算是万宝楼的赔罪。”

苏媚娘将灵石推到叶凡面前，媚眼如丝，“至于这两枚九转聚灵丹嘛……在皇城可是有价无市。不如，咱们上楼，慢慢谈？”
“你确定上楼后，只谈正事？不会对我做点什么……特别的事吧？”
叶凡挑了挑眉，故作紧张地后退了半步。
苏媚娘那方面的“威名”，他可是早有耳闻。
苏媚娘掩嘴轻笑，“这光天化日的，你还怕姐姐会吃了你不成？来，跟姐姐上楼。”
说罢，她那纤纤玉手已拽住叶凡的衣领，不由分说地将他往楼上带。
“完了完了，这小子要完……居然敢跟苏媚娘去阁楼上面独处……”
“就他那小身板，怕是撑不过今晚……估计很快就会被苏媚娘榨干，一滴不剩。”
“年轻人不知天高地厚啊，我看这小子刚刚的样子，魂都已经没了……”
万宝楼外，围观群众窃窃私语，眼中满是同情。
谁不知道苏媚娘看似娇媚，实则是个狠角色？
皇城各大家族的家主，见了她都得礼让三分。
若非如此，万宝楼又怎能在皇城屹立不倒？
叶凡跟着苏媚娘走进房间，鼻尖萦绕着若有若无的幽香。
一侧的帘幔半掩，露出一张凌乱的床榻。
床单褶皱，仿佛上面刚刚经历了一场激烈的“大战”。
苏媚娘走到床边坐下，拍了拍身侧的位置，冲叶凡妩媚一笑，“小弟弟，别那么拘谨，来，到姐姐这儿坐。”

Chapter 5 Imperial City Beauty Su Meiniang (Page 1)
"Tsk tsk, Louzhu Su's figure is really getting more and more attractive..."
"Are you looking for death? Which man who had an affair with Su Meiniang survived more than three months? I heard that they were all squeezed dry..."
"It is said that thirty is like a wolf and forty is like a tiger. This Su Meiniang is a thousand-year-old bastard who won't let go when she bites her!"
"Are you tired of living? If these words reach Master Su's ears, I will castrate all of you!"
"Speaking of which, Mark is so brave that he dares to cause trouble in Wanbao Tower."
"Isn't that right? If Su Lou is angry, the Ye family may be in trouble..."
At this time, many people had gathered outside Wanbao Building to watch the excitement. The men were whispering and couldn't bear to take their eyes away from Su Meiniang.
Ye Fan remained calm and pointed at the trembling shopkeeper beside him, "Use twenty low-grade spiritual stones to forcefully take two Nine-turn Spirit Gathering Pills from me. Is this the way to make money in Wanbao Tower?"
He turned around and hooked his fingers at the shopkeeper. The shopkeeper was already scared out of his wits and offered the elixir tremblingly.
Su Meiniang raised her orchid finger, picked up an elixir and looked at it carefully, "It's really the Nine Revolutions Spirit Gathering Pill... Little brother, where did you get these two elixirs?"
Ye Fan smiled and said nothing, and glanced around.
Su Meiniang understood, glanced at the shopkeeper, then turned to the guards and ordered, "From now on, he is no longer the shopkeeper of Wanbao Tower. Deal with him according to the rules."
"Lord, please forgive me! I know my mistake! I was just obsessed for a moment..."
He knew how cruel the rules of Wanbao Tower were, and if he was not killed, he would have to shed his skin.
However, no matter how much he begged for mercy, Su Meiniang didn't even bother to look at him.
"Little brother, these hundred pieces of low-grade spiritual stones can be regarded as Wanbao Tower's apology."
Su Meiniang pushed the spirit stone in front of Ye Fan with her charming eyes, "As for these two Nine-turn Spirit Gathering Pills... they are priceless in the Imperial City. Why don't we go upstairs and talk slowly?"
"Are you sure you will only talk about business when you go upstairs? You won't do anything... special to me, right?"
Ye Fan raised his eyebrows and took half a step back pretending to be nervous.
He had long heard of Su Meiniang's "prestige".
Su Meiniang covered her mouth and chuckled, "It's broad daylight, are you still afraid that your sister will eat you? Come on, follow your sister upstairs."
After saying that, her delicate hands grabbed Ye Fan's collar and took him upstairs without any explanation.
"It's over, it's over, this guy is going to be finished... How dare he go to the attic with Su Meiniang to be alone..."
"With his small body, I'm afraid he won't be able to survive tonight... He will probably be squeezed dry by Su Meiniang soon, and not a drop will be left."
"Young people don't know how high the sky is. I looked at the way this kid looked just now, and his soul is gone..."
Outside Wanbao Tower, the onlookers whispered, their eyes full of sympathy.
Who doesn't know that Su Meiniang looks charming, but is actually a ruthless character?
The heads of the major families in the imperial city had to be polite when meeting her.
If not, how could Wanbao Tower remain standing in the imperial city?
Ye Fan followed Su Meiniang into the room, with a faint fragrance lingering on the tip of his nose.
The curtain on one side was half-covered, revealing a messy bed.
The sheets were wrinkled, as if they had just experienced a fierce "battle".
Su Meiniang walked to the bed and sat down, patted the seat beside her, and smiled charmingly at Ye Fan, "Little brother, don't be so formal. Come, sit here with sister."
